additionalPrompts: Have OWASP-class vulnerabilities been evaluated explicitly?
Are secrets and tokens handled safely in storage/logs?
Is authorization enforced at all critical boundaries?
Is algorithmic complexity acceptable at target scale?
Can latency-critical paths reduce I/O round trips?
Are throughput bottlenecks observable and measurable?
Are interactive paths keyboard and assistive-tech friendly?
Is semantic structure and labeling sufficient for screen readers?
Is contrast and readability adequate for accessibility standards?
Is structure understandable for future maintainers?
Are responsibilities separated with low coupling?
Is technical debt visible and documented where deferred?
Can caching or batching reduce spend?
Are provisioning assumptions right-sized for expected load?
